registry_asset_append_template.name: Outcome-blind V29R3 signal-close market-median wrapper for 2022-2024 Stage A
registry_asset_append_template.source: Metadata-only wrapper over exact registered CY-033 2022, 2023 and 2024 daily partitions plus the frozen V28R2 validation selected identity; contains no outcome or title content and copies no Parquet rows.
registry_asset_append_template.schema_and_units: Reference manifest only. Stage-A consumer reads raw CNY/share close and preclose plus trade_status, current_day_data_tradable, hard_valid, decision_at, available_at and snapshot_id from exact CY-033 partitions to compute unweighted same-day cross-sectional median returns.
allowed_uses: one exact outcome-blind V29R3 2022-2024 Stage-A computation of completed-signal-day stock return minus the full-market hard-valid PIT median
freeze one exact cohort under the hash-bound preregistration and runner
blocked_uses: outcome, exit, target, portfolio, NAV or result reads
announcement titles, documents, issuer classifiers or issuer-veto inheritance
other thresholds, strategies, current-survivor fallback, live trading, sizing or order generation
activation_gates: manifest and audit hashes are filled from the immutable metadata-only build and remain exact
CY-033 manifest and exact 2022-2024 partition hashes remain exact
V28R2 validation identity freeze and selected identity hashes remain exact
V29R3 preregistration, runner and asset-builder hashes remain exact
one-to-one bounded authorization exists and Stage-A outcome/title permissions remain false

allowed_uses: read only the exact parent selected identity and exact CY-033 2022-2024 partitions after all hash gates pass
compute the frozen signal-close feature and freeze one exact V29R3 cohort without outcomes
blocked_uses: any outcome, result, portfolio or issuer-title read
any 2025-plus read, threshold change, rescue, second cohort, sizing, live or production use
known_limitations: CY-033 is PIT-B rather than strict archival PIT-A
DAILY_NON_CHASING_2PCT is post-hoc to consumed 2018-2021 outcomes
development accepted frequency is highly concentrated on 2018-10-26
Stage A does not authorize Stage B; CY-041 must be built and registered separately after the exact Stage-A freeze exists

required_sequence: Obtain explicit approval to run the metadata-only CY-040 builder; do not invoke Stage A.
Run builder --stage a, verify no Parquet row or outcome/title content was parsed, and freeze manifest/audit hashes.
Re-read the latest registry and validator, fill the two pending manifest/audit hashes, append CY-040 and its one-to-one authorization, and run only targeted registry validation.
Only after the registered activation passes may the separate runner --mode stage-a read the authorized 2022-2024 signal-time rows.
Do not prepare or register CY-041 until the completed immutable Stage-A freeze is independently verified.
